'''Uga Shrine''' (宇賀神社, うがじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine dedicated to {{ill|Ukanomitama|en|Ukanomitama|qid=Q3080728|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama|1=Ukanomitama}} (宇迦之御魂神, 倉稲魂命) or {{ill|Ugajin|en|Ugajin|qid=Q795080|lt=Ugajin|1=Ugajin}}.

* A shrine located in Yamamoto, Yamakizaki, {{ill|Imabetsu|en|Imabetsu|qid=Q1362366|lt=Imabetsu Town|1=Imabetsu}}, {{ill|Aomori Prefecture|en|Aomori Prefecture|qid=Q71699|lt=Aomori Prefecture|1=Aomori Prefecture}}.
* A shrine in Miyamoto Kō, {{ill|Tajima|ja|田島|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tajima|1=Q18989218|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q18989218}}, {{ill|Minamiaizu|en|Minamiaizu|qid=Q1205058|lt=Minamiaizu Town|1=Minamiaizu}}, {{ill|Fukushima Prefecture|en|Fukushima Prefecture|qid=Q71707|lt=Fukushima Prefecture|1=Fukushima Prefecture}} - {{ill|Tade Uga Shrine|ja|田出宇賀神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tade Uga Shrine|1=Tadeuga Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q85882438}}.
* A shrine in {{ill|Fuma|ja|府馬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuma|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Katori, Chiba|en|Katori, Chiba|qid=Q858357|lt=Katori City|1=Katori, Chiba}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture|1=Chiba Prefecture}} - Known for the {{ill|Great Camphor Tree of Fuma|ja|府馬の大クス|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Great Camphor Tree of Fuma|1=Q11486115|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11486115}}.
* A shrine in Iizasa, {{ill|Tako, Chiba|en|Tako, Chiba|qid=Q1202807|lt=Tako Town|1=Tako, Chiba}}, Chiba Prefecture - {{ill|Uga Shrine (Tako Town, Iizasa)|ja|宇賀神社 (多古町飯笹)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Uga Shrine (Tako Town, Iizasa)|qq=}}.
* A shrine in Nishikoiso, {{ill|Ōiso|en|Ōiso|qid=Q385023|lt=Ōiso Town|1=Ōiso}}, {{ill|Kanagawa Prefecture|en|Kanagawa Prefecture|qid=Q127513|lt=Kanagawa Prefecture|1=Kanagawa Prefecture}}.
